mainEntity.name: Are you a staffing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. TaaSFlow is a Talent as a Service (TaaS) platform — a flat-fee talent sourcing service. We build and deliver qualified candidate pipelines, but you own all interviews, offers, and hiring decisions. We never place candidates or charge salary-based placement fees.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge placement fees or salary percentages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike traditional agencies that charge 20-30% of a candidate's salary, TaaSFlow uses transparent flat-fee pricing — whether it's a one-off package or a monthly subscription. Please check our pricing page for current rates.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between one-off and subscription?

acceptedAnswer.text: One-off packages are for companies with occasional or seasonal hiring needs — you pay once and get ranked candidates in 14 days. Subscription plans are for teams hiring continuously (15+ positions/month) at a predictable monthly rate.

mainEntity.name: How fast do you deliver candidates?

acceptedAnswer.text: For one-off packages, all positions are handled simultaneously with a 14-day turnaround. For subscription clients, you receive ranked shortlists on a weekly cadence starting from week one.

mainEntity.name: What do we get in a delivery?

acceptedAnswer.text: A ranked shortlist of qualified candidates with scoring, fit notes, compensation details, availability, and next-step recommendations. Plus pipeline metrics and logistics summaries.

mainEntity.name: What roles and regions do you support?

acceptedAnswer.text: We specialize in professional roles across sales, operations, technical, and customer-facing positions. We provide global coverage across North America, Europe, APAC, and emerging markets.

mainEntity.name: How does candidate scoring work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every candidate is scored across four dimensions: Role Fit (35%), Evidence (30%), Logistics (20%), and Signal (15%). Scoring is tied directly to your job description and requirements, with AI-assisted ranking and human review.

mainEntity.name: Can clients customize scoring weights?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Each position has default scoring weights, but you can adjust priorities — for example, weighting must-have skills higher or prioritizing availability. Changes apply to your position only.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from us to begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Role profile (job description, must-haves, seniority), compensation range, location/remote requirements, interview process overview, and what success looks like in this role.

mainEntity.name: Can we use this alongside agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Many teams use TaaSFlow for recurring, high-volume roles while reserving agencies for specialized executive searches. The models complement each other.

mainEntity.name: How do you protect employer brand?

acceptedAnswer.text: All outreach is professional, personalized, and respectful. We never spam or misrepresent opportunities. Every candidate interaction reflects positively on your organization.

mainEntity.name: How do you handle data privacy and GDPR?

acceptedAnswer.text: We follow GDPR-compliant data handling practices. All candidate and client data is securely stored with role-based access controls. We collect only what's necessary, with explicit consent, and support data access and deletion requests.

TaaSFlow is a subscription recruiting service — you pay a flat monthly fee instead of a percentage of salary, and we deliver pre-screened, ranked candidates on a fixed cadence. mainEntity.name: Are you a staffing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Agencies charge a percentage of first-year salary per hire and disappear between placements. TaaSFlow is a subscription recruiting service: a flat monthly fee, weekly candidate delivery, and a workspace your team owns.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge placement fees or salary percentages?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Pricing is a flat subscription — the same whether you hire one person or ten. No success fees, no salary percentages, no back-end invoices.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between one-off recruiting and subscription?

acceptedAnswer.text: One-off recruiting resets every hire: new brief, new agency, new fees. A TaaSFlow subscription is continuous — sourcing, screening, and delivery keep running so pipeline and learnings compound across roles.

mainEntity.name: How do contracts and cancellation work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Month-to-month by default. You can pause or cancel between billing cycles. Annual plans include a discount and can be cancelled at renewal.

mainEntity.name: How fast do you deliver candidates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most subscriptions produce a first ranked shortlist within one to two weeks of intake, then a rolling weekly delivery of new candidates until the role is closed.

mainEntity.name: What do we get in a weekly delivery?

acceptedAnswer.text: A ranked shortlist inside your workspace. Each candidate carries an evidence-based score, a recruiter-written fit narrative, strengths and gaps, and a one-click path to shortlist, request an interview, or send feedback.

mainEntity.name: What roles and regions do you support?

acceptedAnswer.text: TaaSFlow supports individual contributor and leadership roles across engineering, product, design, data, revenue, operations, and G&A. Sourcing runs globally with active coverage in the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East.

mainEntity.name: How does candidate scoring work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every candidate is scored 0–100 against the exact requirements in your intake. Scores are evidence-first: each requirement is either supported by a citation from the CV, partially met, or missing. You see the evidence, not just a number.

mainEntity.name: Can we customise scoring weights for our role?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Requirements you flag as must-have or dealbreaker are weighted heavier and can cap a candidate's score. Preferred requirements add lift. Everything is set during intake and can be updated as the role evolves.

mainEntity.name: Can we add screening questions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You define role-specific questions during intake — free text, boolean, or multiple choice. Answers are stored with the application and shown alongside the CV evidence.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from us to begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: An intake session (or the online intake form) covering the role, must-haves, dealbreakers, and hiring context. If you have a job description, share it — otherwise we can build one from the intake.

mainEntity.name: Can we use TaaSFlow alongside an agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many clients run TaaSFlow next to an existing agency, especially during transition. Because you own the pipeline, there is no conflict on candidates we source.

mainEntity.name: How do you protect our employer brand?

acceptedAnswer.text: All outreach is co-branded with your company. Messaging, tone, and role framing are agreed during intake, and any candidate-facing content is reviewed before it goes out.

mainEntity.name: How do you handle data privacy and GDPR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Candidate data is stored under explicit consent, retained only as long as needed to run the process, and deleted on request. You can export or purge candidate records from your workspace at any time.

mainEntity.name: Do we own the pipeline if we cancel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every candidate sourced under your subscription belongs to you — during the subscription and after cancellation. No re-engagement fees to talk to your own candidates.

mainEntity.name: Are you a staffing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Agencies charge a percentage of first-year salary per hire and disappear between placements. TaaSFlow is a subscription recruiting service: a flat monthly fee, weekly candidate delivery, and a workspace your team owns.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge placement fees or salary percentages?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Pricing is a flat subscription — the same whether you hire one person or ten. No success fees, no salary percentages, no back-end invoices.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between one-off recruiting and subscription?

acceptedAnswer.text: One-off recruiting resets every hire: new brief, new agency, new fees. A TaaSFlow subscription is continuous — sourcing, screening, and delivery keep running so pipeline and learnings compound across roles.

mainEntity.name: How do contracts and cancellation work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Month-to-month by default. You can pause or cancel between billing cycles. Annual plans include a discount and can be cancelled at renewal.

mainEntity.name: How fast do you deliver candidates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most subscriptions produce a first ranked shortlist within one to two weeks of intake, then a rolling weekly delivery of new candidates until the role is closed.

mainEntity.name: What do we get in a weekly delivery?

acceptedAnswer.text: A ranked shortlist inside your workspace. Each candidate carries an evidence-based score, a recruiter-written fit narrative, strengths and gaps, and a one-click path to shortlist, request an interview, or send feedback.

mainEntity.name: What roles and regions do you support?

acceptedAnswer.text: TaaSFlow supports individual contributor and leadership roles across engineering, product, design, data, revenue, operations, and G&A. Sourcing runs globally with active coverage in the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East.

mainEntity.name: How does candidate scoring work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every candidate is scored 0–100 against the exact requirements in your intake. Scores are evidence-first: each requirement is either supported by a citation from the CV, partially met, or missing. You see the evidence, not just a number.

mainEntity.name: Can we customise scoring weights for our role?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Requirements you flag as must-have or dealbreaker are weighted heavier and can cap a candidate's score. Preferred requirements add lift. Everything is set during intake and can be updated as the role evolves.

mainEntity.name: Can we add screening questions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You define role-specific questions during intake — free text, boolean, or multiple choice. Answers are stored with the application and shown alongside the CV evidence.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from us to begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: An intake session (or the online intake form) covering the role, must-haves, dealbreakers, and hiring context. If you have a job description, share it — otherwise we can build one from the intake.

mainEntity.name: Can we use TaaSFlow alongside an agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many clients run TaaSFlow next to an existing agency, especially during transition. Because you own the pipeline, there is no conflict on candidates we source.

mainEntity.name: How do you protect our employer brand?

acceptedAnswer.text: All outreach is co-branded with your company. Messaging, tone, and role framing are agreed during intake, and any candidate-facing content is reviewed before it goes out.

mainEntity.name: How do you handle data privacy and GDPR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Candidate data is stored under explicit consent, retained only as long as needed to run the process, and deleted on request. You can export or purge candidate records from your workspace at any time.

mainEntity.name: Do we own the pipeline if we cancel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every candidate sourced under your subscription belongs to you — during the subscription and after cancellation. No re-engagement fees to talk to your own candidates.
